A [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''member''' of the [[Kla (clan)|Kla]] clan mated with a [[Elegos A'Kla's father|male]] of the [[A]] clan, resulting in the birth of [[Elegos A'Kla]]. This Caamasi was also the sibling of famed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ylenic It'kla]].
